import sys

def main():
    import sys
    w1 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    h1 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    w2 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    h2 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    
    # Calculate the total area covered by the ship
    total_area = w1 * h1 + w2 * h2
    
    # Calculate the overlapping area between the two rectangles
    overlap_area = w2 * h1
    
    # Calculate the area of the ship without double counting the overlap
    ship_area = total_area - overlap_area
    
    # Calculate the number of neighboring cells around the ship
    # Each side of the first rectangle contributes (w1 + 2) * (h1 + 2) - w1 * h1 neighbors
    # Each side of the second rectangle contributes (w2 + 2) * (h2 + 2) - w2 * h2 neighbors
    # However, we need to subtract the overlapping parts that were counted twice
    # The top part of the first rectangle and the bottom part of the second rectangle overlap
    # This overlap contributes (w2 + 2) * 2 - w2 neighbors
    
    # Total neighbors calculation
    neighbors = (w1 + 2) * (h1 + 2) - w1 * h1 + (w2 + 2) * (h2 + 2) - w2 * h2 - ((w2 + 2) * 2 - w2)
    
    # Print the result
    print(neighbors)
